params.name: from
params.description: The starting date for data retrieval.

params.name: to
params.description: The end date for data retrieval. The `to` date must be later than the `from` date and within one year of the `from` date.

params.name: breakdown_type
params.description: Specifies how data is grouped. By default, it returns the total consumption for the entire organization. If set to `workspace`, the data will be grouped by Workspace.

params.name: workspace_ids
params.description: A list of Workspace IDs to filter the results.
